phase_name: Gated live envelope confirmation against the production library

objectives.description: Draft and get user approval for the test design
Confirm DOI not already in library via normalization + zotero-read.sh search
Run --dry-run item-add preview and record output
Run real item-add through zotero-write.sh; capture jq '.data'
Run real attach-file through zotero-write.sh; capture jq '.data'
Record confirmed field paths in zotero-item-creation.md section 2
Report created item key and rollback instruction

deviations.description: Record the confirmed field paths in zotero-item-creation.md section 2 and note which probed candidates resolved
deviations.reason: Only the item-key path (.data.key) could be live-confirmed. Both real attach attempts (internal item-add attach, and standalone attach-file) failed identically with a Zotero API 413 storage-quota error before reaching a successful attachment envelope, so none of the four attachment-key candidates could be confirmed or eliminated. This is a real external API constraint (account storage quota already exceeded, and the only alternative --via-bridge route is unavailable since Zotero desktop is not running), not a scope reduction or gate decline.
deviations.annotation: *(completed: .data.key confirmed as the item-key path; the four attachment-key candidates remain unconfirmed -- see Reasoned Exclusions below)*
